description: Scheduled events at a park within a date range — ranger programs, festivals, tours, interpretive events — answering "what's happening at Yellowstone this weekend?" with title, dates and times, location, category, fee, and registration links. Get park codes from nps_find_parks. Paginates by page number, not offset. Many parks list few or no events; an empty result is not an error.

dateEnd.description: End of the date window (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with dateStart.

dateStart.description: Start of the date window (YYYY-MM-DD). Combine with dateEnd to bound the search (e.g. a weekend). Omit for upcoming events from today.

pageNumber.description: 1-based page number. Increment to page through results beyond the first page.

pageSize.description: Maximum events to return per page (1–50). Paginates by page number, not offset — use with pageNumber to walk through results.

parkCode.description: Park code, or comma-separated list (e.g. "yell") — 4-letter lowercase codes. Get codes from nps_find_parks. Provide parkCode or stateCode.

stateCode.description: Two-letter state code, or comma-separated list (e.g. "WY", "WY,MT,ID"). Returns events across NPS sites in those states.

name: nps_find_events

appliedFilters.description: Echo of parkCode/stateCode/date window/query as applied.

cap.description: Page size applied (populated when results were truncated).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date`: dateStart/dateEnd not YYYY-MM-DD, not a real calendar date (e.g. 2026-02-31), or dateEnd < dateStart. `invalid_park_code`: A parkCode token isn't 4 lowercase letters. `invalid_state_code`: A stateCode token isn't two letters. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

events.description: Events matching the park/state and date window.

items.description: A single scheduled event with dates, times, and registration links.

category.description: Event category (e.g. "Regular Event", "Ranger Programs"), or null.

dateEnd.description: Event end date (YYYY-MM-DD), or null. For a recurring event this is the anchor date, not the last occurrence — see occurrenceDates and isRecurring.

dateStart.description: Event start date (YYYY-MM-DD), or null. For a recurring event this is the series anchor (its original first date), which can predate your requested window — use occurrenceDates for the dates that actually fall in the window.

feeInfo.description: Fee details when not free (free text), or null.

isRecurring.description: True when this is a recurring series (multiple occurrence dates); dateStart/dateEnd then hold the series anchor and occurrenceDates the actual dates.

location.description: Event location within the park (free text), or null.

occurrenceDates.description: Dates (YYYY-MM-DD) the event actually occurs within the requested dateStart/dateEnd window; with no window, every remaining occurrence from today through the series end. Empty when the window matches no occurrence. For a recurring series, dateStart/dateEnd hold the series anchor instead.

parkCode.description: Park code the event belongs to, or null if absent.

times.description: Scheduled time slots for the event. May be empty (all-day or unspecified).

notice.description: Guidance on the result set: how to widen a search that matched nothing, the pageNumber for the next page when more events matched, the way back when pageNumber ran past the end, and a warning when NPS reports errors for the request.

shown.description: Events returned on this page (populated when the page was capped by pageSize).

totalCount.description: Total events matching the filter before the page limit.

truncated.description: True when more matching events follow this page; absent on the last page of the result.

title: national-parks-mcp-server: find events
